topics.title: The Case of the Fifth Word: the story and its characters
topics.ncert_sections: The Case of the Fifth Word, Part I

concepts.learning_objective: Describe Leroy (Encyclopedia) Brown's traits and his role in solving his father's cases.
Recall the facts of the Diamond Mart hold-up and the suspicion against Nolan and Davenport.

topics.title: The Case of the Fifth Word: the coded message
topics.ncert_sections: The Case of the Fifth Word, Part II

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how Nolan's four-word code stood for days of the week and pointed to the fir tree.
Distinguish statements of fact from statements of opinion in the story.

topics.title: The Case of the Fifth Word: language and grammar
topics.ncert_sections: The Case of the Fifth Word, Let us learn

concepts.learning_objective: Use the phrasal verbs from the story according to their meanings.
Identify homophone pairs and correct spoonerisms.
Change Wh- and Yes/No questions from direct into reported speech.

topics.title: The Magic Brush of Dreams: story, theme and symbols

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the events of the poem and contrast Gopi's and the Zamindar's aims.
Interpret the symbols and the changing tone of the poem.

topics.title: The Magic Brush of Dreams: poetic form and language
topics.ncert_sections: The Magic Brush of Dreams, Let us learn and Let us speak

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the poem's genre, rhyme scheme and use of repetition.
Match interjections to emotions and the verb 'draw' to its meanings in context.
Recall the location and unique feature of each natural wonder described.
Explain the scientific causes behind the phenomena described.
Use binomials and synonyms of words from the text correctly.
Distinguish participles used as adjectives from gerunds used as nouns.
